    • getIntersectedNode

      public org.jogamp.java3d.Node getIntersectedNode(int distanceIndex)
      Return the node intersected by the pick ray associated with this mouse event. The distance index is used to specify one of a set of intersectiong nodes where 0 is the closest node.
      Parameters:
      distanceIndex - the index of the destination node
      Returns:
      the intersecting node

    • getIntersection

      public org.jogamp.vecmath.Point3f getIntersection(org.jogamp.vecmath.Point3f ret)
      Get the point intersected by the pick ray associated with this mouse event. The returned value may be null if the event did not occur over a 3D object.
      Parameters:
      ret - the Point3f object where to store the result
      Returns:
      the intersection point for this event

    • getLocalIntersection

      public org.jogamp.vecmath.Point3f getLocalIntersection(org.jogamp.vecmath.Point3f ret)
      Get the intersection point for this event in the local coordinate space relative to the event source object. The returned Potint3f object may holds NaNs as the coordinate if the event did not occur over a 3D object.
      Parameters:
      ret - the Vector3f object where to store the result
      Returns:
      the intersection point for this event

    • getIntersectedComponent3D

      public Component3D getIntersectedComponent3D(int distanceIndex)
      Return the Component3D at the specified index in the node info where 0 is the closest intersected node. The method searches for the first Component3D that is a subclass of componentClass. The distanceIndex relates to the distance of the picked object from the eye, index 0 is the object closest to the user and subsequent objects are further away.
      Parameters:
      distanceIndex - the index of the pick
      Returns:
      the Component3D at the give pick index, or null if no Component3D was picked.

    • getIntersectedComponent3D

      public Component3D getIntersectedComponent3D(int distanceIndex, Class componentClass)
      Return the Component3D at the specified index in the node info where 0 is the closest intersected node. The method searches for the first Component3D that is a subclass of componentClass. The distanceIndex relates to the distance of the picked object from the eye, index 0 is the object closest to the user and subsequent objects are further away.
      Parameters:
      distanceIndex - the index of the pick
      componentClass - class of the component to find
      Returns:
      the Component3D at the give pick index, or null if no Component3D of the correct class was found.
